subject: Money
title: Greater Fool Theory
description: A quick win: understand Greater Fool Theory.

hook.text: You buy a stock at $100 knowing it's worth $50. You don't care—someone else will pay $120 tomorrow.

buildup.text: The greater fool theory: you can profit from an overpriced asset as long as a bigger fool buys it from you.

discovery.text: In a bubble, the price doesn't matter. What matters is momentum. Buyers don't calculate value; they chase returns.

twist.text: The last buyer is the greatest fool. When the music stops, whoever holds the asset absorbs the total loss.

climax.text: Every bubble participant thinks they'll sell before the crash. Statistically, most of them are wrong.

punchline.text: Everyone's a genius until the music stops.

quiz.question: What is the greater fool theory?
options: You can profit if someone else pays a higher price later
